actions.text: Under authority of the order of the Senate of September 30, 2026, ordered read twice and referred to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.

dimensions.assessment: Affects visitors to the Lincoln Memorial and the Department of the Interior.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Interior shall remove the plaque at Lincoln Memorial placed pursuant to Public Law 106-365

dimensions.assessment: Narrow, localized physical change involving the replacement of a single commemorative plaque.
dimensions.evidence: install a new plaque commemorating the speech of Martin Luther King, Jr., known as the 'I Have a Dream' speech.

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the use of federal funds and private contributions for the plaque replacement without specifying total dollar amounts.
dimensions.evidence: Federal funds may be used to-- (1) remove the plaque... and (2) design, procure, and install the new plaque.

dimensions.assessment: Applies exclusively to a single designated monument project under the Commemorative Works Act.
dimensions.evidence: Chapter 89 of title 40, United States Code... shall apply to the design and placement of the new plaque.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent physical modification to the Lincoln Memorial site.
dimensions.evidence: install a new plaque commemorating the speech of Martin Luther King, Jr.

missing_information: Total estimated cost of designing, procuring, and installing the new plaque.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Secretary of the Interior to replace a specific plaque at the Lincoln Memorial commemorating the 'I Have a Dream' speech.
